about.intro: Hi, I'm Miguel Angel, a full-stack developer with more than 8 years of experience, based in Cuautitlán Izcalli, State of Mexico. I studied Computer Science at Universidad Nacional Autónoma de México (UNAM). I specialize in LMS platforms, internal systems, and robust APIs with .NET and Vue, plus mobile development with Flutter. Native Spanish, intermediate English.
